verdict.rationale: Capacities' own pricing page documents 'Grant others view-only access to notes' as its sharing capability, indicating sharing exists but only in a read-only mode, not real-time collaborative editing where multiple people can edit without conflicts. There's no documentation of multi-user simultaneous editing, conflict resolution, or shared write access to a vault/space. Missing for 10: evidence of multi-editor real-time collaboration, conflict/merge handling, and collaborator write permissions beyond view-only.
